description: The CAA check of the names

name.description: The domain name as asked (a wildcard name keeps its `*.`)

state.description: `allowed`: no CAA set applies or it lets the CA issue. `refused`: the records do not let the CA issue (see `record`). `limited`: the record limits the CA's account (`accounturi`), which NPMpro does not compare. `unknown`: a lookup failed (see `reason`). `not-checked`: not looked at (a pattern name, an unknown CA identity, or no result cached yet)

found_at.description: The name whose CAA records apply (the name itself or a parent); null when there are none

record.description: The relevant CAA record or records as text, at most 500 characters; null when there is none to show

error_i18n.description: A translation key (`error.caa-no-identity`) when the CA does not name its CAA identity

names.description: One result per name, each once, in the order asked
